approval_gates: two independent native/expert reviews for every dialect formulation
academic approval of rubric and analysis plan
six-item pilot and API budget check

models.snapshot: stable-GA; record provider modelVersion for every response

model_selection_rationale: Two distinct providers, stable/GA endpoints, text-capable general models, low published token rates; not a claim of equal model capability.

generation.system_instruction: Responde en español con precisión y de forma concisa. Respeta el formato y las restricciones explícitas. Si la consulta no determina una respuesta única, indica los supuestos. No añadas datos locales que no se soliciten.

dialect_anchors.co: urban conversational Bogotá; not representative of all Colombia
dialect_anchors.mx: urban conversational Mexico City; not representative of all Mexico
dialect_anchors.rio: urban conversational Buenos Aires; not representative of all Rioplatense areas
dialect_anchors.std: pan-Hispanic neutral written Spanish, not a claim that a dialect-free variety exists

consistency_metric.per_cell_range: max-min of three response ratings after averaging raters
consistency_metric.exact_agreement: share of item-model-dialect-dimension cells with identical ratings on all three repeats

statistical_plan.analysis_unit: item; aggregate raters then three repeats before dialect-control paired contrast
statistical_plan.primary_test: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank on paired item differences
statistical_plan.holm_family: three dialect-control contrasts within each model-by-dimension family

budget_assumptions.estimate_scope: paid standard API rates at post-2026 introductory Google price; actual usage/prices must be checked at execution

notes: Model identifiers selected from current official documentation on 2026-11-03; recheck endpoint and rates immediately before running.
Dialect versions require two independent native/expert reviews before the six-item pilot.
Statistical plan is an operational recommendation; document supervisor approval before primary collection.
Paid API tier only; the model cost estimate is token-assumption based and excludes free-tier data policies.
